passages.text: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor His ear too dull to hear.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is strong.
His arm is not too short to save.
The LORD hears clearly.
His ear is not too dull to hear.
passages.original: הֵ֛ן לֹֽא־ קָצְרָ֥ה יַד־ יְהוָ֖ה מֵֽהוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְלֹא־ כָבְדָ֥ה אָזְנ֖וֹ מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃

passages.text: But your iniquities have built barriers between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you, so that He does not hear.
passages.sermon:
Your iniquities stand between you and God.
Your sins separate you from Him.
Your sins hide His face from you.
God does not hear you because of your sins.
passages.original: כִּ֤י אִם־ עֲוֺנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ הָי֣וּ מַבְדִּלִ֔ים בֵּינֵכֶ֕ם לְבֵ֖ין אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם וְחַטֹּֽאותֵיכֶ֗ם הִסְתִּ֧ירוּ פָנִ֛ים מִכֶּ֖ם מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃

passages.text: For your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters injustice.
passages.sermon:
God sees your actions.
Your hands are stained with blood.
Your fingers are covered with iniquity.
Your lips have spoken lies.
Your tongue mutters injustice.
passages.original: כִּ֤י כַפֵּיכֶם֙ נְגֹאֲל֣וּ בַדָּ֔ם וְאֶצְבְּעוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בֶּֽעָוֺ֑ן שִׂפְתֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ דִּבְּרוּ־ שֶׁ֔קֶר לְשׁוֹנְכֶ֖ם עַוְלָ֥ה תֶהְגֶּֽה׃

passages.text: No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case honestly. They rely on empty pleas; they tell lies; they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
passages.sermon:
The people do not call for justice.
No one pleads his case with honesty.
They trust in empty words.
They speak lies.
They plan trouble.
They give birth to sin.
passages.original: אֵין־ קֹרֵ֣א בְצֶ֔דֶק וְאֵ֥ין נִשְׁפָּ֖ט בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה בָּט֤וֹחַ עַל־ תֹּ֙הוּ֙ וְדַבֶּר־ שָׁ֔וְא הָר֥וֹ עָמָ֖ל וְהוֹלֵ֥יד אָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die; crack one open, and a viper is hatched.
passages.sermon:
The people act with evil and deceit.
They hatch the eggs of vipers.
They weave a spider’s web.
Anyone who eats their eggs will die.
If someone cracks one of their eggs, a viper will come out.
passages.original: בֵּיצֵ֤י צִפְעוֹנִי֙ בִּקֵּ֔עוּ וְקוּרֵ֥י עַכָּבִ֖ישׁ יֶאֱרֹ֑גוּ הָאֹכֵ֤ל מִבֵּֽיצֵיהֶם֙ יָמ֔וּת וְהַזּוּרֶ֖ה תִּבָּקַ֥ע אֶפְעֶֽה׃

passages.text: Their cobwebs cannot be made into clothing, and they cannot cover themselves with their works. Their deeds are sinful deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.
passages.sermon:
The people do evil.
They do not act with justice or honesty.
They create things like cobwebs.
Their cobwebs cannot become clothing.
They cannot cover themselves with what they do.
Their actions are sinful.
They commit violence with their hands.
passages.original: קֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לֹא־ יִהְי֣וּ לְבֶ֔גֶד וְלֹ֥א יִתְכַּסּ֖וּ בְּמַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶם֙ מַֽעֲשֵׂי־ אָ֔וֶן וּפֹ֥עַל חָמָ֖ס בְּכַפֵּיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Their feet run to evil; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are sinful thoughts; ruin and destruction lie in their wake.
passages.sermon:
These people do evil.
They hurry to do wrong.
They quickly shed innocent blood.
Their thoughts are full of sin.
They plan evil things.
Where they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
passages.original: רַגְלֵיהֶם֙ לָרַ֣ע יָרֻ֔צוּ וִֽימַהֲר֔וּ לִשְׁפֹּ֖ךְ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָ֔וֶן שֹׁ֥ד וָשֶׁ֖בֶר בִּמְסִלּוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.
passages.sermon:
These people do not know the way of peace.
There is no justice in their paths.
They make their roads crooked.
Anyone who walks on these roads will not know peace.
passages.original: דֶּ֤רֶךְ שָׁלוֹם֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ וְאֵ֥ין מִשְׁפָּ֖ט בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָ֑ם נְתִיבֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ עִקְּשׁ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם כֹּ֚ל דֹּרֵ֣ךְ בָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א יָדַ֖ע שָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We hope for light, but there is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in gloom.
passages.sermon:
The people have sinned and turned from God.
Justice stays far away from us.
Righteousness does not come to us.
We hope for light.
But we see only darkness.
We look for brightness.
But we walk in deep gloom.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן רָחַ֤ק מִשְׁפָּט֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְלֹ֥א תַשִּׂיגֵ֖נוּ צְדָקָ֑ה נְקַוֶּ֤ה לָאוֹר֙ וְהִנֵּה־ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ לִנְגֹה֖וֹת בָּאֲפֵל֥וֹת נְהַלֵּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Like the blind, we feel our way along the wall, groping like those without eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.
passages.sermon:
We are people who have sinned and turned from God.
We act like blind people.
We feel our way along the wall.
We grope as if we have no eyes.
We stumble in the middle of the day.
It is as if it were dark, even when it is bright.
Among strong and healthy people, we are like dead people.
passages.original: נְגַֽשְׁשָׁ֤ה כַֽעִוְרִים֙ קִ֔יר וּכְאֵ֥ין עֵינַ֖יִם נְגַשֵּׁ֑שָׁה כָּשַׁ֤לְנוּ בַֽצָּהֳרַ֙יִם֙ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁף בָּאַשְׁמַנִּ֖ים כַּמֵּתִֽים׃

passages.text: We all growl like bears and moan like doves. We hope for justice, but find none, for salvation, but it is far from us.
passages.sermon:
We are the people of Israel.
We are suffering because of our sins.
We all growl like bears.
We all moan like doves.
We hope for justice.
But we do not find justice.
We hope for salvation.
But salvation is far from us.
passages.original: נֶהֱמֶ֤ה כַדֻּבִּים֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וְכַיּוֹנִ֖ים הָגֹ֣ה נֶהְגֶּ֑ה נְקַוֶּ֤ה לַמִּשְׁפָּט֙ וָאַ֔יִן לִֽישׁוּעָ֖ה רָחֲקָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities: rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.
passages.sermon:
We have sinned many times against God.
Our sins stand before God.
Our sins speak against us.
Our wrongdoings stay with us.
We know our iniquities.
We rebel against the LORD.
We deny the LORD.
We turn away from our God.
We speak words of oppression.
We speak words of rebellion.
We plan lies in our hearts.
We speak lies from our hearts.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ רַבּ֤וּ פְשָׁעֵ֙ינוּ֙ נֶגְדֶּ֔ךָ וְחַטֹּאותֵ֖ינוּ עָ֣נְתָה בָּ֑נוּ כִּֽי־ פְשָׁעֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֔נוּ וַעֲוֺנֹתֵ֖ינוּ יְדַֽעֲנֽוּם׃ פָּשֹׁ֤עַ וְכַחֵשׁ֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וְנָס֖וֹג מֵאַחַ֣ר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ דַּבֶּר־ עֹ֣שֶׁק וְסָרָ֔ה הֹר֧וֹ וְהֹג֛וֹ מִלֵּ֖ב דִּבְרֵי־ שָֽׁקֶר׃

passages.text: So justice is turned away, and righteousness stands at a distance. For truth has stumbled in the public square, and honesty cannot enter.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the people's condition in Isaiah's time.
Justice is not present.
People have turned justice away.
Righteousness does not come near.
Righteousness stands far away.
Truth has fallen in the streets.
Truth cannot stand in public places.
Honesty cannot enter.
People do not allow honesty to come in.
passages.original: וְהֻסַּ֤ג אָחוֹר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה מֵרָח֣וֹק תַּעֲמֹ֑ד כִּֽי־ כָשְׁלָ֤ה בָֽרְחוֹב֙ אֱמֶ֔ת וּנְכֹחָ֖ה לֹא־ תוּכַ֥ל לָבֽוֹא׃

passages.text: Truth is missing, and whoever turns from evil becomes prey. The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.
passages.sermon:
Truth is missing.
Anyone who turns from evil becomes a victim.
The LORD looked at this.
The LORD was displeased.
There was no justice.
passages.original: וַתְּהִ֤י הָֽאֱמֶת֙ נֶעְדֶּ֔רֶת וְסָ֥ר מֵרָ֖ע מִשְׁתּוֹלֵ֑ל וַיַּ֧רְא יְהוָ֛ה וַיֵּ֥רַע בְּעֵינָ֖יו כִּֽי־ אֵ֥ין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: He saw that there was no man; He was amazed that there was no one to intercede. So His own arm brought salvation, and His own righteousness sustained Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD looked.
He saw there was no man.
He saw no one would help.
He was amazed.
No one would intercede.
The LORD acted Himself.
His own arm brought salvation.
His own righteousness gave Him strength.
passages.original: וַיַּרְא֙ כִּֽי־ אֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵ֖ם כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין מַפְגִּ֑יעַ וַתּ֤וֹשַֽׁע לוֹ֙ זְרֹע֔וֹ וְצִדְקָת֖וֹ הִ֥יא סְמָכָֽתְהוּ׃

passages.text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance and wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal.
passages.sermon:
The LORD saw that there was no justice.
The LORD acted to save His people.
The LORD put on righteousness like a breastplate.
He wore the helmet of salvation on His head.
He put on garments of vengeance.
He wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal.
passages.original: וַיִּלְבַּ֤שׁ צְדָקָה֙ כַּשִּׁרְיָ֔ן וְכ֥וֹבַע יְשׁוּעָ֖ה בְּרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּלְבַּ֞שׁ בִּגְדֵ֤י נָקָם֙ תִּלְבֹּ֔שֶׁת וַיַּ֥עַט כַּמְעִ֖יל קִנְאָֽה׃

passages.text: So He will repay according to their deeds: fury to His enemies, retribution to His foes, and recompense to the islands.
passages.sermon:
God sees the actions of all people.
God repays each person according to their deeds.
God gives fury to His enemies.
God gives retribution to His foes.
God gives recompense to the distant lands.
passages.original: כְּעַ֤ל גְּמֻלוֹת֙ כְּעַ֣ל יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם חֵמָ֣ה לְצָרָ֔יו גְּמ֖וּל לְאֹֽיְבָ֑יו לָאִיִּ֖ים גְּמ֥וּל יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃

passages.text: So shall they fear the name of the LORD where the sun sets, and His glory where it rises. For He will come like a raging flood, driven by the breath of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
People will fear the name of the LORD in the west.
People will honor His glory in the east.
The LORD will come with great power.
He will come like a rushing flood.
The breath of the LORD will drive this flood.
passages.original: וְיִֽירְא֤וּ מִֽמַּעֲרָב֙ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וּמִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֶת־ כְּבוֹד֑וֹ כִּֽי־ יָב֤וֹא כַנָּהָר֙ צָ֔ר ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה נֹ֥סְסָה בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD promises a Redeemer.
The Redeemer will come to Zion.
The Redeemer will come to people in Jacob.
These people turn away from their sins.
The LORD declares this.
passages.original: וּבָ֤א לְצִיּוֹן֙ גּוֹאֵ֔ל וּלְשָׁבֵ֥י פֶ֖שַׁע בְּיַֽעֲקֹ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,” says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD makes a covenant with His people.
The LORD says, “My Spirit is upon you.”
The LORD says, “I have put My words in your mouth.”
My Spirit will not leave you.
My words will not leave your mouth.
My words will not leave the mouths of your children.
My words will not leave the mouths of your grandchildren.
This will be true from now on.
This will be true forever.
The LORD has spoken.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה רוּחִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔יךָ וּדְבָרַ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֣מְתִּי בְּפִ֑יךָ לֹֽא־ יָמ֡וּשׁוּ מִפִּיךָ֩ וּמִפִּ֨י זַרְעֲךָ֜ וּמִפִּ֨י זֶ֤רַע זַרְעֲךָ֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מֵעַתָּ֖ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃ס
